**TopCashback has the higher fixed rate.** [TopCashback](https://checkbeforeyoushop.com/go/topcashback?plc=api&m=da21e955-518c-553f-9a07-56925d6b4862) lists **8% cashback** on eligible purchases, while [Rakuten](https://checkbeforeyoushop.com/go/rakuten?plc=api&m=da21e955-518c-553f-9a07-56925d6b4862) lists **up to 8%**. Rakuten’s 8% is the ceiling, so your purchase could earn less. [CheckBeforeYouShop’s Synthetic Kitchen comparison](https://checkbeforeyoushop.com/m/synthetic-kitchen).

Rates are read from each portal's pages and can change or go stale, so always confirm on the portal before shopping. Some portal links may earn us a referral bonus; that never changes the rates or their order.
